subject: Request: CFO waiver for non-standard sandbox uplift and credit bridge
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-18 14:12 PDT
Subject: Request: CFO waiver for non-standard sandbox uplift and credit bridge

Team —

Quick ask: Vectora Labs (strategic med-tech prospect) is requesting a one-off exception to our standard PLG sandbox limits. Ask is: 45-day sandbox extension + temporary uplift to 1M free tokens (from standard 200k) and a 15% first-quarter discount on Dedicated capacity if they convert within 60 days.

Why this is different:
- Vectora is a pre-series B company building a clinical decision-support feature that integrates with hospital EHRs — successful POC has strong potential to convert to a Reserved Dedicated contract across multiple accounts (expected ARR > $1.1M over 24 months).
- They've completed our security intake (SOC2 artifacts attached) and are willing to sign an accelerated MSA addendum to narrow liability windows.
- Sales forecast: conversion probability at current runway is 55%; with the uplift and short-term discount we estimate conversion probability rises to ~78%.

Risks and mitigations:
- Unit economics: 1M free tokens is above PLG threshold but we propose gating: advance approval contingent on (a) PoC success criteria in attached MAP, (b) commitment to a technical pilot plan, and (c) legal-approved addendum limiting credits to evaluation usage only.
- Capacity: if they spike, we route to sandbox-gpu pool and enable autoscale with burst caps defined in policy.

Requesting a CFO-level (Aditya) signoff on:
1) One-off 1M token credit grant for Vectora Labs, valid for 45 days starting on approval date.
2) One-time 15% discount on first quarter of Dedicated capacity if contracted within 60 days of approval.

Attachments: Vectora_Opportunity_Summary.pdf (deal economics), Proposed_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (success criteria), SOC2-Complete-Checklist.pdf

If approved we will: update the HubSpot deal, add a billing memo to prevent auto-invoicing of credits, and kick off legal for the addendum.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want details.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19 09:07 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: CFO waiver for non-standard sandbox uplift and credit bridge

Sean —

Thanks for the concise summary. High level — I support making pragmatic exceptions for strategically aligned opportunities when controls are in place. A couple of questions before I mark as approved:
1) Confirm that the credits are strictly for evaluation token consumption and that we can revoke remaining balance if they do not meet MAP milestones.
2) Confirm legal review on the proposed addendum timeline; I don’t want open-ended commercial exposure.
3) Provide the expected timeline from PoC completion to a signature for Dedicated (what triggers the 15% discount).

If the answers are: (a) revocable credits, (b) legal signoff within 72 hours of approval, (c) conversion trigger tied to a signed order within 60 days, then consider this approved from a finance/COO viewpoint. Please capture the approval in Deal Desk and include an explicit clawback clause.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19 11:34 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: CFO waiver for non-standard sandbox uplift and credit bridge

Aditya — thanks. Quick replies inline: 
1) Credits: yes — we will tag credits to their account and include admin-only revoke rights; usage beyond MAP flagged to salesops and legal.
2) Legal timeline: Chloe, can you confirm you can review and turn around the addendum within 72 hours if we push?
3) Timeline to signature: PoC success criteria target is Nov 30; if met, expected signed order within 30 days. 60 days is our outer window for the discount entitlement.

I’ll update HubSpot and add billing memo and proposed clawback language. If legal confirms the 72-hour turnaround I will mark this approved and ask Finance to apply the credits.

Sean

Date: 2026-10-20 09:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: CFO waiver for non-standard sandbox uplift and credit bridge

Team —

I reviewed the attached MAP and the proposed clawback language. Legal can turn around the addendum in 48 hours provided the following are included:
- Explicit revocation clause tied to MAP milestone miss or misuse of credits.
- Credit cap and expiration date (45 days after issuance).
- Liability & indemnity language consistent with our standard MSA (no changes to core indemnities).
- Billing memo to state credits are evaluation-only and will not be invoiced unless Converted Order executed.

Assuming Finance applies the credits only after legal uploads the addendum to DocuSign and we record the approval in HubSpot, I sign off. Please proceed and confirm once DocuSign link is sent.

Chloe Martin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai
